description: Election Commission - L. S. Herath was elected as the member of the Galigamuwa P/S - H. R. G. H. B. Jayasekara was elected as the member of the Rambukkana P/S - J. N. A. Bacha was elected as the member of the Mawanella P/S
reasoning: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Pradeshiya Sabhas) due to members ceasing to belong to their political parties, under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for local authorities, including declarations of elected members to fill these vacancies, which falls under election-related matters.
